sources.note: Village of Jeffersonville, By-Laws (2004; official village website): Article 3: the annual meeting elects the number of trustees needed to maintain a total of five trustees, for three-year terms
Village of Jeffersonville, trustee meeting minutes, February 9, 2026: James Sergeant, Fred Bauer, Nathan Mascolino, Donald Lange, and Tom Wyckoff sit as trustees
Village of Jeffersonville, trustee meeting minutes, April 13, 2026: the same board sits (Lange absent) and signs the annual meeting warning
Village of Jeffersonville, trustee meeting minutes, May 11, 2026, the first meeting after the annual meeting: all five trustees sit -- Sergeant, Bauer, Mascolino, Lange, and Wyckoff

Village of Jeffersonville, By-Laws (2004; official village website): Article 3: the annual meeting elects a moderator; no official source publishes the current holder, so the post is created without a membership
